TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Day 6, 29th September 2025.

Construction of Access Road bypassing Airport second runway from Bill Clinton Drive by Tungan Madaki settlement including a 4- span bridge.

This is to again inform the FCT motoring public, especially those that will be heading towards the airport and returning back, that traffic will be closely monitored to ensure seamless movement as dignitaries will be heading toward the venue at Bill Clinton drive by Tunga Madaki junction.

The two adjoining u-turns as you drive on Bill Clinton drive near Correctional Service Headquarters will be slightly affected and managed to ensure seamless flow to the airport.

Traffic and security personnel will be deployed accordingly and will commence at 0800hrs.

— Head Traffic DRTS.
